name: Granite State Gas Transmission Pipeline
researcher_notes: No roster row; PHMSA operator list shows Granite State Gas Transmission Inc active since 1995. Unitil's 2025 annual report (Form 10-K for fiscal 2025) says Granite State is an interstate gas transmission pipeline company operating 85 miles of underground pipeline, mainly in Maine and New Hampshire, serving Northern Utilities, regulated by FERC. The March 2012 quarterly report says 86 miles. Both are one origin (Unitil filings), so not independent. The line is existing and operating, an older never-captured line, so the add-threshold step test is met by it being built. Start and end points (Haverhill, Massachusetts to Westbrook, Maine) came from a search summary only and were not found in a verifiable document, so they are left blank. Owner is Unitil with no legal form found; owner entity lookup found no close match, so it would be a new entity (Unitil Corporation likely). Diameter, capacity and route not researched. Federal Register notice from April 1997 only concerns an oil pipeline lease and is not a ref for length. Several New Hampshire PUC links from search returned 404.
